fields.good_management: Estimated share of municipal solid waste scientifically processed/managed.
fields.bad_management: Estimated share not scientifically processed or requiring disposal/management improvement.
fields.un_published: Estimated share for which city-level public reporting/accounting is incomplete; NOT an official SBM-U metric.

official_basis.primary: Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U) city-wise report of Municipal Solid Waste Management
official_basis.primary_metric: Waste Generation (MT/D), Waste Processed (MT/D), Waste Processing %
official_basis.national_context: MoHUA reported 81% waste processing nationally in 2026.
official_basis.important: Do not present these city bands as live government measurements. For production, replace each estimate with ULB/MIS values and sampling/reporting date.
